text_block_list.text:
After a successful debut, Симболи Рудольф
sets her
sights on the Saudi Arabia R.C.
to ensure that she
acquits herself well in
the Classics.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Even after the race is over, she upholds
her pride
as the Emperor and the
student council president
by taking both
her press interviews and student
council
duties in stride.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Such a capable Umamusume hardly has
to rely on
a trainer at all, but in the
name of our shared
dream, I resolve to
do everything I can to support
her if she
needs it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
